Metadata.Goal: 为标准 Domain Operation request/catalog 与 depa ORM domain runtime 增加天级时间上下文、封闭关系查询 predicate、稳定系统记录时间和 read-only effect guard。
Metadata.Description: 以 additive timeline contract 保持现有 requests；在 allocation 前做 exact timeline admission；把受信任 RuntimeQuery predicate 投影到 depa ORM public AST；一次 execution 只捕获一个 recordedAt；read-only handler 写入 fail closed。

TaskSpace.name: add-day-timeline-operation-contracts
TaskSpace.Description: Additive timeline request/catalog contract and trusted relational predicate runtime boundary.

TaskGroup.name: Timeline Contract And Admission
TaskGroup.Description: 先用 request/catalog tests 冻结 timeline union、日期语法和 definition match，再实现 public DTO 与 exact validation。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 非时间 request 保持原 shape 和行为
非法日历日、reversed range、unknown key/mode 与 required mismatch 均有 path-aware issue
timeline mismatch 在 runtime allocation 前失败

Task.name: Write timeline contract characterization and red tests
Task.Description: 锁定现有 exact request baseline，并为 as-of/effective-on/range、optional recordedAt、closed keys、calendar validation 和 catalog matching 写失败测试。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: positive/negative timeline cases 在实现前验红，现有 request fixtures 继续通过
测试覆盖非法 leap day、非零填充、day 字段 timestamp、reversed range、missing required 与 unsupported mode

Task.name: Implement additive timeline DTO parser and catalog match
Task.Description: 增加 closed timeline union 与 definition timeline capability；实现真实 Gregorian day 和 UTC instant validation、exact keys、required/mode/granularity catalog match，不改变五维 identity。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: timeline DTO 可从公共 root 导入并通过 JSON roundtrip，legacy requests 不需要 timeline
parser/catalog tests 全绿且 mismatch path 精确定位到 $.timeline 或 definition timeline

TaskGroup.name: Predicate Recorded Time And Effect Guard
TaskGroup.Description: 用 public depa ORM AST 扩展 trusted RuntimeQuery，并把 recordedAt/effect boundary 接入实际 operation execution。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: predicate grammar 只有 comparison/null/and/or，逻辑节点非空，不接受 raw SQL
所有 scalar value 经 Literal/adapter 参数化路径，不做 SQL 字符串拼接
一次 parent/child execution 使用同一个 system recordedAt
read-only write 被稳定 diagnostic 拒绝且事务零提交

Task.name: Write runtime predicate clock and effect red tests
Task.Description: 为 nested AND/OR、Eq/Ne/Lt/Le/Gt/Ge、IS NULL/IS NOT NULL、where+predicate AND、empty logical reject、single recordedAt、child propagation 与 read-only rollback 写失败测试。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: AST tests 能证明半开 valid/recorded predicate 与 null infinity，无 raw SQL 或 value interpolation
runtime tests 能证明 injected clock 只调用一次且 parent/children 共享 recordedAt
read-only handler 人工写入在 mutation 前失败并返回 READ_ONLY_OPERATION_WRITE_REJECTED

Task.name: Implement trusted predicate projection and execution boundaries
Task.Description: 实现封闭 RuntimeQueryPredicate 到 ColumnRef/Comparison/IsNull/Logical 的递归投影；execution 在 preflight 后捕获一个 UTC recordedAt 并传入 handler context；write 根据 admitted definition effect fail closed。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: public query adapter 生成结构正确且不可变的 depa ORM AST，invalid trusted shape 抛出明确错误
recordedAt 在一次 execution 稳定、跨 execution 独立，并且不是 request 可控字段
read-only write diagnostic 稳定，outer transaction 回滚，mutation summary 不宣称提交

TaskGroup.name: Regression And Convergence
TaskGroup.Description: 运行 affected-package baseline、typecheck/build、public boundary 与 fresh direction review，确认公共扩展没有组织域泄漏或旧行为回退。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 规划前实跑的 315 affected-package tests 保持通过，并叠加本 track 新测试
两个 package build、public import guard、XML/XNL/diff checks 通过
新增 public DTO、predicate 与 handler context types 只从两个 package root 导出，external consumer 不导入 src/private/internal subpath

Task.name: Run package regression build and boundary checks
Task.Description: 运行 contract/runtime focused tests、五个受影响 package baseline、两个 package build、public dependency/import guards、git diff check。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 所有新增与既有测试通过，失败数为零

build 与 public boundary 通过；OperationTimelineContext/OperationTimelineCapabilitiesDto 从 contract root 导出，RuntimeQueryPredicate/DomainOperationHandlerContext.recordedAt 从 runtime root 导出；external consumer 不使用 src/private/internal subpath
runtime 源码不含组织域、server 或 UI 依赖，新增 depa ORM imports 仍在既有 public-root allowlist 内

Task.name: Audit behavior authority and track evidence
Task.Description: 核对 behavior cases、acceptance、source diff、preflight lifecycle evidence、AttractorCheck 与 mission G2 映射，修复任何 completion-critical gap。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 每个 behavior case 有测试或命令证据，track XML/decisions/deltas strict-valid
fresh reviewer 对 public authority、effect boundary 和 scope 给出 PASS
